Sub WriteUTF8WithBOM(filePath As String, content As String)
    Dim stream As Object
    
    Set stream = CreateObject("ADODB.Stream")
    With stream
        .Type = 2  ' 文本模式
        .Charset = "utf-8" ' 指定 UTF-8
        .Open
        .WriteText content
        ' 保存为文件
        .SaveToFile filePath, 2 ' 2=覆盖，如果已存在
        .Close
    End With
    Set stream = Nothing
End Sub

                 . WriteText   content 
                 '   保存 为 文件 
                 . SaveToFile   filePath ,   2   '   2 = 覆盖 ， 如果 已 存在
